security_spec.violation_condition: When a trap (interrupt or exception) is taken during execution of an RV32 Zilsd LD instruction and the Linux kernel saves the partially-updated register pair to a signal frame via setup_sigcontext() or exposes it via ptrace_getregs(), without validating that the load had completed atomically.
security_spec.summary: Zilsd LD/SD instructions on RV32 have non-atomic register pair updates and explicitly permit partial register pair writeback before traps (Zilsd_ld_resume_trap), creating an information leak window when the kernel exposes inconsistent register pair state to userspace through signal delivery or ptrace.
